---
title: Stateful R execution
---

# Stateful R execution

The cells on this page share one page-scoped R session.

```{r}
#| label: r-setup
#| echo: true
values <- c(2, 4, 6)
total <- sum(values)
```

```{r}
#| label: r-streams
cat(sprintf("R total: %d\n", total))
message("Intentional R stderr")
```

```{r}
#| label: r-markdown
IRdisplay::display_markdown(sprintf("**R total:** `%d`", total))
```

```{r}
#| label: r-figure
#| fig-alt: A bar labeled with the R total
svg <- sprintf(
  paste0(
    '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="160" height="80" ',
    'viewBox="0 0 160 80" role="img">',
    '<rect x="10" y="10" width="%d" height="40" fill="#3366cc" />',
    '<text x="10" y="70">total = %d</text></svg>'
  ),
  total * 10,
  total
)
IRdisplay::display_svg(svg)
```

```{r}
#| label: r-error
#| error: true
stop("intentional R fixture error")
```
